channel.title: JSON Outline Schema
channel.description: Documentation for the JSON Outline Schema used by HAXcms for content structure, site navigation, metadata, and the Skeleton API.

item.title: Overview
item.description: JSON Outline Schema (JOS) is a standard way of expressing and storing the relationship between objects. It gives you a simple way of linking data together to form an outline of related concepts and entities—title, author, description, and a flat list of items that reference one another by parent ID. HAXcms uses JOS as the backbone for every site's site.json manifest: the outline of pages, their order, their nesting, and a flexible metadata container that downstream systems (like HAXcms itself...

item.title: HAXcms Metadata Conventions
item.description: JSON Outline Schema is intentionally flexible about metadata . In practice, HAXcms uses stable metadata groups that are important to document for interoperability (including ingest into systems like PRAW), even though these groups are not formally required by JOS itself. metadata.site Holds site-level information and operational settings used by HAXcms: name — machine name for the site (folder / instance alignment). created / updated — unix timestamps. logo , domain , tags , homePageId — comm...

item.title: Skeleton API
item.description: The Skeleton API builds on JSON Outline Schema to describe reusable starter "skeletons" for HAXcms sites. A skeleton is a JSON document that combines: High-level metadata about the skeleton itself. Initial HAXcms site settings (name, description, theme). A JSON Outline Schema–style outline of pages to create. Optional theme and visual metadata for dashboards and UIs. item.title: Skeleton API HTTP Endpoints
item.description: Skeleton JSON documents (described in Skeleton API ) are exposed via two HAXcms API endpoints, implemented in both the PHP ( Operations::skeletonsList / Operations::getSkeleton ) and Node.js backends. GET /skeletonsList Returns the list of available skeletons visible to the current user. Query parameters user_token – required request token for the active user (same token used by other HAXcms CMS endpoints).
